anchors.description: Beige duplex electrical outlet cover plate on the blue kitchen wall, long side horizontal; span measured between its visible left and right edge corners
anchors.visible_evidence: Beige rectangular cover plate mounted on the blue backsplash wall; a black NEMA plug is inserted in its left socket with the cord running up-left. The plate's long horizontal edge runs from the left corner (490,231) to the right corner (525,223).
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Cover plate assumed standard single-gang 4.5 in long side; could be a jumbo plate (5.25 in) and the sampled corner points sit slightly inside the true edges, so the span may understate the full 4.5 in dimension.
